thread:
sophia_sales: Urgent — NimbusX demo on in 20m. They're seeing a burst of 429s and occasional 502s when they push a scripted traffic spike (~300rps). Can ops/eng help triage now?

ryan_oncall: looking. which route + model? any request ids?

sophia_sales: route: /v1/chat (hosted); model: redwood-micro. sample req: rx_1c9d4. log: 
```
WARN 429 RateLimitExceeded req=rx_1c9d4 pool=hosted-front reason=burst
ERROR 502 UpstreamError req=rx_1c9d4 upstream=api-gateway timeout=15s
```

lee_runtime: 502s could be gateway backlog; 429s mean our per-account burst bucket hit. Did they enable client-side retries aggressively?

anya_se: they mentioned a parallel load generator. I suspect client retry storms making the burst bucket collapse. Recommend immediate soft-throttle and enable 429->linear-backoff on their side.

olivia_security: customer also pinged about a security questionnaire item: "data residency for ephemeral logs" — can someone confirm retention policy for hosted trials?

ryan_oncall: applied temp throttling rule: account=nimbusx max_burst=50 at 11:12 UTC. monitoring.

lee_runtime: infra metrics: front proxy queue depth spiked at 11:10:34, worker pool saturated. backlog cleared after throttle but a couple 502s persisted due to upstream timeout.

anya_se: sent them an example backoff snippet to reduce retries:
```js
// client suggestion
if (resp.status === 429) await sleep(1000 + Math.random()*500);
```

sophia_sales: customer accepted cutting generator to 150rps for the remainder of demo. they asked if we can guarantee no data leaves EU nodes (they're in EU).

olivia_security: hosted trials use region routing but logs may be processed in central observability for now. I'll DM legal for exact clause. For now tell them EU region only for inference and we redact PII in logs by default.

lee_runtime: long-term fix: bump per-account burst bucket and add a short-lived warmup ramp to absorb scripted spikes. I can open ENG ticket and prototype a warmup token.

ryan_oncall: deploy-bot: applied throttle rule.

deploy-bot: throttle configuration updated for account=nimbusx by ryan_oncall at 11:12:02 UTC

anya_se: created PREM-498 for client-retry-guidance, assigned to solutions-eng.

lee_runtime: ENG-7402 opened to investigate proxy queue tuning and adaptive warmup. ETA 3 days for proposal. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7402

sophia_sales: thanks all — i'll follow up with pricing note re: burst credits and the security answer. please ping here with any prod changes. :pray:

ryan_oncall: monitoring green after throttling; 429s fell from ~5% to <0.1% and 502s stopped. will keep an eye for 30m.
